newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat aide says Israel has declared war.
newsitem.headline: Arafat aide says Israel has declared war.

text.p: An aide to Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said on Thursday Israeli decisions following a suicide bombing in Jerusalem were "a declaration of war against the Authority and against the Palestinian people".
"And instead of fighting terror they decided to fight the Palestinian Authority," Arafat aide Nabil Abu Rdainah told Israel's Channel Two Television.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet demanded Arafat clamp down on Moslem militants responsible for double suicide bombings that killed 13 people and wounded 170 at a Jerusalem market on Wednesday.
Israel suspended peace talks over the attack, made arrests and threatened to re-enter Palestinian areas to seize "terrorists" if Arafat's forces failed to do the job.
Earlier on Thursday, Abu Rdainah said Israel brought Wednesday's slaughter on itself through hardline policies that were frustrating peace efforts.

Arafat has ordered his security forces to crack down on militants suspected of involvement in the bombings. A leaflet claimed responsibility for the attack in the name of the Moslem militant Hamas movement.
